product.name: Premium
product.description: Thola imilayezo yengxoxo ye-AI engu-{count} ngenyanga nemibala yokugqamisa oyikhethayo ku-Nibomo.
portal.headline: Phatha ukubhalisa kwakho kwe-Nibomo Premium
offer.title: Premium
offer.description: Imilayezo eyengeziwe yengxoxo ye-AI nombala wokugqamisa owukhethayo.
offer.accentBenefit: Khetha umbala osuvele usethiwe noma owakho umbala wokugqamisa.
offer.trial: Izinsuku ezingu-7 mahhala. Ngemva kwalokho, {price} ngenyanga.
offer.renewalDisclosure: Ukubhalisa kwakho kuvuselelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo uze ukukhansele. Kuphathe noma ukukhansele kuzilungiselelo zokubhalisa.
offer.guestExplanation: Faka i-imeyili ku-akhawunti yakho ngaphambi kokubhalisa ukuze ukwazi ukubuyisela ukufinyelela kwakho kwenye idivayisi.
limit.title: Usufinyelele emkhawulweni wakho we-AI wanyanga zonke
limit.freeExplanation: I-Premium ikunikeza imilayezo yengxoxo ye-AI engu-{count} ngenyanga.
limit.paidExplanation: Isabelo sakho se-AI sanyanga zonke sizovuselelwa ngo-{date}.
ownKey.explanation: Ungasebenzisa ukhiye wakho we-OpenAI kunoma yiluphi uhlelo. Ukusebenzisa lowo khiye kukuvumela ukuba usebenzise i-AI ngaphandle kokusebenzisa isabelo sakho se-Nibomo, kodwa akuvuli izici ze-Premium. I-OpenAI ikhokhisa lokho kusetshenziswa ngokwehlukana.
checkout.delayed: Sisakuqinisekisa ukubhalisa kwakho. Hlola isimo sakho ngaphambi kokuqala enye inqubo yokukhokha.
checkout.interrupted: Inqubo yokukhokha iphazamisekile. Hlola isimo sokubhalisa kwakho ngaphambi kokuzama futhi.
subscription.cancelledRenewal: Ukufinyelela kuyaqhubeka kuze kube ngu-{date}. Ukubhalisa kwakho ngeke kuvuselelwe.
subscription.paymentProblem: Kunodaba enkokhelweni yakho oludinga ukunakwa. Buyekeza indlela yakho yokukhokha ukuze ugcine ukubhalisa kwakho.
subscription.lifetimeWithSubscription: Unokufinyelela impilo yonke nokunye ukubhalisa okuhlukile. Ungaphatha lokho kubhalisa ngezansi.
subscription.unknown: Asikwazanga ukuqinisekisa isimo sokubhalisa kwakho. Hlola ukuxhumeka kwakho bese uzama futhi.
subscription.accountChanged: I-akhawunti yakho ishintshile. Vula izilungiselelo zokubhalisa ze-akhawunti yakho yamanje.
offer.trialDisclosure: Kudingeka indlela yokukhokha. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-7, uzokhokhiswa {price} ngenyanga ngaphandle uma ukhansela ngaphambi kokuphela kwesivivinyo.
offer.trialEligibility: Ikhasimende ngalinye le-Stripe lithola isivivinyo samahhala esisodwa. Isivivinyo sangaphambilini se-Apple noma se-Google asikuthinti ukufaneleka.
offer.allowanceWindow: Isabelo sakho semilayezo ye-AI sivuselelwa inyanga ngayinye yekhalenda ngokwesikhathi se-UTC, kungakhathaliseki usuku okhokhiswa ngalo.
email.trialReminderSubject: Isivivinyo sakho se-Nibomo Premium siphela maduze
email.trialReminderBody: Isivivinyo sakho samahhala se-Nibomo Premium siphela ngo-{date}. Ngemva kwesivivinyo, ukubhalisa kwakho kuzovuselelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo ngenani eliyisisekelo lenyanga elingu-{price}, kuhlanganise nezintela ezisebenzayo. I-Stripe ibonisa inani lokugcina elizokhokhiswa ngohlobo lwemali okhokhiswa ngalo. Ukuze ugweme ukukhokhiswa kokuqala, khansela ngaphambi kokuphela kwesivivinyo. Phatha noma ukhansele ukubhalisa kwakho kuzilungiselelo zokubhalisa: {url}
email.paymentReceiptBody: Siyitholile inkokhelo yakho engu-{price}. Buka irisidi lakho: {url}
email.refundReceiptBody: Imali yakho engu-{price} ibuyiselwe. Buka imininingwane: {url}
deletion.warning: Ukususa i-akhawunti yakho ye-Nibomo kukhansela ukuvuselelwa kwesikhathi esizayo kokubhalisa kwakho kwe-Nibomo okukhokhiswa nge-Stripe. Uzolahlekelwa ukufinyelela kule akhawunti. Ukubhalisa okukhokhiswa nge-Apple noma nge-Google kufanele kukhanselwe ngokwehlukana ngalowo mhlinzeki.
deletion.cancelling: Kukhanselwa ukuvuselelwa kokubhalisa kwakho kwe-Stripe ngaphambi kokususa i-akhawunti yakho...
deletion.cancellationFailed: Asikwazanga ukuqinisekisa ukukhanselwa kokuvuselelwa kokubhalisa kwakho kwe-Stripe. I-akhawunti yakho ayikasuswa. Zama futhi noma uxhumane nabasekeli.
